## Tile-array sizes (the 3-tile gap)

Port:      const uint8_t elephant_tiles[720] = {
Reference: const uint8_t sprite_tiles[768] = {

Port      = 720 bytes / 16 bytes-per-tile = 45 tiles
Reference = 768 bytes / 16 bytes-per-tile = 48 tiles
Gap       = 3 unique tiles missing from port emission

## Tile-id range used by the DSL (Metasprites.kt)

DSL unique baseId values (from `tile(x, y, baseId)` calls): 0..47 (48 distinct ids)
Port `elephant_tiles[720]` only contains tiles 0..44 (45 distinct ids)
=> DSL baseIds 45, 46, 47 dereference past the end of `elephant_tiles[]` -- garbage pixels.
